items.title: What we know about the global Microsoft outage
items.description: Microsoft has said the outage was not caused by a cyber-security incident, but efforts to fix the issues have so far been largely unsuccessful.

items.title: Watch: How a server outage took down Microsoft Teams and Outlook
items.description: A Microsoft outage is affecting services including Teams, Outlook and AI software Copilot.

items.title: Ex-Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang summoned to testify before Congress about affair with alleged Chinese spy
items.description: Huang abruptly quit on Thursday as head of one of the world's most valuable companies after revelations of alleged extramarital affairs.

items.title: Zelensky welcomes US bringing Europe into Russia-Ukraine peace talks
items.description: The Ukrainian president says it makes sense for European leaders to be involved as Ukraine hopes to eventually join the EU.

items.title: UN watchdog 'increasingly concerned' over uninspected Iran nuclear site
items.description: It says it has never been able to visit a uranium enrichment plant at Isfahan which Iran announced over a year ago.

items.title: African Miss Universe beauty queens in limbo as US visa restrictions bite
items.description: Hall has been seeking a US visa in South Africa as other African beauty queens face similar hurdles.

items.title: Nigerian university in mourning after four students die at post-exam party
items.description: The university has banned all parties, while investigations are underway to find the cause of the students' deaths.

items.title: North Korean hackers used fake video calls in $400m crypto hack, says FBI
items.description: More than 900 victims are thought to have fallen prey to the FaceStealer scheme in the last 18 months.

items.title: Hegseth awards medal to war memorial guard who reprimanded him and group
items.description: Specialist Thomas Iglesias had shouted at Hegseth's group to be quiet after they could be heard talking and laughing at the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier.

items.title: Russian warship hit by Ukrainian drone in Gulf of Finland
items.description: The attack is thought to be the first time Ukrainian drones have attacked a Russian ship in an open stretch of the Baltic Sea.

items.title: Australian footballers will not be charged after hotel incident, police say
items.description: Four Sydney Swans players had been under investigation after an alleged sexual assault after a game in Melbourne.

items.title: Will the Eurovision Song Contest succeed in Asia?
items.description: The world’s biggest and longest-running song contest is coming to Asia, with eleven countries competing in Bangkok, Thailand on Saturday.
